messages:
ana: Quick flag: a few customers report tiny charges after stream reconnects when background prefetch is enabled. Seen 1-3 provisional tokens extra.

ben: Any example trace?

ana: Short trace: req=ab-123 route=eu-west prefetch=1 chunks=2 reconnect=1 provisional=31 confirmed=29

cyrus: Probable race: prefetch emits provisional before resume confirms actual suffix. Ledger keeps provisional and never links.

marta: Two fixes: (1) runtime dedupe by prefix match on resume; (2) ledger-side TTL: emit provisional with origin=prefetch + link_id, auto-convert if confirmation arrives within 700ms.

ben: I prefer TTL link approach for safety; prefix dedupe has off-by-one risks.

cyrus: Agree. Minimal schema change: add "origin" and "link_id" nullable. Router attaches source tag. Compaction job updated to collapse link_id pairs.

marta: Console change: show origin in waterfall and suppress transient provisional->confirmed to reduce support noise.

billing-bot: ALERT eu-west provisional-prefetch spike: count=120 threshold=100 at 2026-03-22T15:00Z
\b en: I'll open ENG-4601 with trace and TTL proposal, assign owners: cyrus (ledger/migration), marta (console), ben (runtime tests). Aim: staging canary 48h, prod roll 1 week post verification.

ana: Thanks — let's keep TTL short and default new fields null for Dedicated/Private compatibility.
